question_text: A researcher notices differences in the shapes of leaves on different trees of the same species. Which of these is the most accurate way to record these differences?
choices: A: record the numbers of leaves in a data table
B: photograph each leaf type using a camera
C: record the sizes of different leaves in a notebook
D: calculate the percentages of all leaf types using a calculator
